column1: # Compute nodes no job of a staged submit script (scripts/training/staged_submit.sh) may run on, one per line:
# Every job such a script submits carries these nodes in --exclude, which isambard_sbatch merges with the nodes of its
# own bad-nodes log. That log is a file of the cluster, not of the repository: it expires an entry after a week, and
# an account that cannot read it excludes nothing from it. Add a node only when a failure is pinned to its hostname
# (CLAUDE.md, "Bad compute nodes"), and remove it once the site has repaired it. The date is YYYY-MM-DD and the reason
# nid011097 fails without always failing: a run on it can end in a NaN gradient, or go on with a corrupted tensor. Its
# third run lost four positions of a loss mask at one iteration and nothing else, which only the exact
nid011097|2026-10-11|corrupts GPU memory: NaN gradients in jobs 7254925 and 7351484, four loss-mask positions zeroed in job 7351485
